719-813-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
719-813-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Xenograft, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2558-6277-6798--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-6277-6798--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
On Wings of Gold triggers. Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a 1/1 creature token. The +1/+1 bonus from On Wings of Gold is countered by the -1/-1 from the templated card
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2313-3099-4762-8320.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting three +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Conclave Mentor and Yoshimaru.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2455-2707-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Reito Sentinel by paying {3}, causing you to put Time Walk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

687-2438-5004--73.easyPrerequisites: The creature with persist or undying doesn't  have a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it respective to its ability.
687-2438-5004--73.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cathodion.
Cathodion triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing your persist/undying creature.
The creature's persist/undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a vigilance counter and the appropriate choice of a +1/+1 or -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing  both counters from your persist/undying creature and one counter from another creature, causing yourself to mill three cards and return Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

529-1115-3197-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

147-728-3890.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-728-3890.description:
Cast Unearth by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unearth.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unearth, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Unearth copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

967-2097-3809-3899-7087.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

3184-4766-6797--190.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the non-Yomiji legendary creature.
Yomiji and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Yomiji trigger, returning the legendary card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting that card onto the battlefield from your hand and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Phantom Train trigger.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

880-2757-7885.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping a basic land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

372-2781-3563.manaNeeded: {5}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-2781-3563.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Felidar Guardian's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

4311-5078-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-1137-6972.description:
Activate Rith's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Rith's Attendant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat.

2523-2869-3455.description:
Cast Vizier of Many Faces by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Vizier of Many Faces into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Vizier of Many Faces dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Vizier of Many Faces that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Vizier of Many Faces token instead.
2523-2869-3455.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2265-3099-4762-6774.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Hardened Scales and Loading Zone.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

1824-2906-4549.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed, or are venturing in, Tomb of Annihilation.
1824-2906-4549.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
1824-2906-4549.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
When Acererak enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Acererak, adding {B}.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2079-3259-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-7357.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

4067-6281-7013-7206.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
4067-6281-7013-7206.description:
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Dundoolin Weaver.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Dundoolin Weaver that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Dundoolin Weaver token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dundoolin Weaver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat.

4063-4771-5220-6900.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

486-1978-6410.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least three Goblins.
486-1978-6410.description:
Cause Howlsquad Heavy to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Howlsquad Heavy.
Repeat from step 2.

1778-5220-5231-6900.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

5078-6890-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
5078-6890-6900.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1399-1606-1680-4249.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 4.
1399-1606-1680-4249.description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to your devotion to it.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

1792-3338--44.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
1792-3338--44.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control.
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate the creature by tapping it, returning the artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1575-1651-4231.description:
Activate Nuka-Cola Vending Machine by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a Food, Clue and Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Clue, untapping Nuka-Cola Vending Machine.
Repeat.

643-1247-5832.notablePrerequisites:
Joraga Treespeaker has at least five level counters on it.
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
643-1247-5832.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1778-2292-5220-5683.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Memnite from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Memnite and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.

5184-5742-5743-6089.description:
Activate Mary Read and Anne Bonny by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and discard Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter the battlefield, Skyswimmer Koi triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to draw a card.
Holding priority, activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw a card and discard Gilded Assault Cart.
Repeat from step 2.
5184-5742-5743-6089.notes: You may resolve the other Skyswimmer Koi trigger, choosing to loot and get tapped Treasure tokens from Mary Read and Anne Bonny.

457-1409-5334.easyPrerequisites:
"Human" or "Artificer" chosen with Roaming Throne.
Deadeye Navigator paired with Urza.
457-1409-5334.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it triggers twice and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers once.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve both Urza triggers, creating two 0/0 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the Constructs, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

1479-2783-5478-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2783-5478-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

307-2985-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Dokuchi Silencer and Palinchron do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Dokuchi Silencer or Palinchron.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
307-2985-3542.description:
Declare Palinchron and Dokuchi Silencer as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Dokuchi Silencer from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is tapped and attacking.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Dokuchi Silencer's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{B} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Dokuchi Silencer onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Palinchron tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2429-3129-3193.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Olivia deathtouch.
2429-3129-3193.description:
Give Olivia deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Olivia's first ability by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, destroying it due to Olivia's deathtouch, and putting two +1/+1 counters on Olivia.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have a way to give Olivia deathtouch indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1409-2034-3895-4720.description:
Activate Diregraf Horde by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Diregraf Horde enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Diregraf Horde.
Resolve the Diregraf Horde trigger, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombies, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat.

862-2644-4763-5147.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching Sai of the Shinobi to Crimson Kobolds.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

90-1364-1371-4398.description:
Cast Endless Swarm by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Eye of the Storm and Hive Mind trigger.
Resolve the Eye of the Storm trigger, exiling Endless Swarm, and then copying each instant and sorcery card exiled with Eye of the Storm, and allowing you to cast the copies without paying their mana costs.
Choose not to cast the copy of Endless Swarm as permitted by Eye of the Storm.
Resolve the Hive Mind trigger from step 2, causing each opponent to copy Endless Swarm.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Endless Swarm, causing them to create a 1/1 Snake creature token for each card in their hand, and then be unable to cast spells for the rest of the game.
The Snakes enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining Endless Swarm copy.
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, their copy of Endless Swarm triggers, copying itself.
Resolve the copy of Endless Swarm, causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Snake creature token for each card in their hand.
The Snakes enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 9.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor

1558-2740-4089-4231.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Tamiyo's Journal triggers, creating three Food, three Clue, and three Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2665-2743-3094.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Progenitor Mimic's trigger.
Resolve both triggers, creating two token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

732-3821-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{R}.
732-3821-4222.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Felhide Spiritbinder.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Peregrine Drake with haste.
The token Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.

1303-1769-2034.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

539-4657-4974.easyPrerequisites: You control two mana-producing lands other than Magus of the Candelabra.
539-4657-4974.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers twice, adding {2}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping the two lands and Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.

38-618-3580.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
The Lightning Crafter token enters the battlefield, championing Kiki-JIki.
Activate the Lightning Crafter token by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing the Lightning Crafter token, adding {R}.
The Lightning Crafter token leaves the battlefield, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.
